items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: there were three trumpet players, myself, Mike Delay and somebody else

ctx.x: I told him yes and he said be out at Warner Brothers at such and such a time and day, and I was working with the school board, I was working at Hollywood High, I'll never forget it; that's not far from Warner Brothers, you know. I did a lot of angling to get away from school and make a record, play in the movies. Anyway, I got off to make this audition, because most of them jobs I got in the movies, they had about two or three trumpet players and they picked whoever they wanted.

This particular day I was out at Warner Brothers and there were three trumpet players, myself, Mike Delay and somebody else, and they picked me and they out to the studio told me to go / another day sometime after that. First I had to go to the studio for wardrobe. The picture was Bourbon Street Beat.
This was a series; it wasn't just one movie, a one-shot movie, it was a series, because we were out there for about one day a week for four, five weeks.
